acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, AEO is highly effective for attracting local buyers. By optimizing your content for location-specific queries, such as 'best family neighborhoods in Chicago' or 'average rent in Houston,' your brokerage can directly appear in local search results and answer snippets. This direct approach helps potential clients find your specific expertise and listings within their desired geographic area, increasing the likelihood of generating qualified local leads who are ready to make a move.
